, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom. Tom was a brave boy. He loved to play outside, but he was scared of the big mountain.
One day, Tom's mom said, "Tom, let's go to the top of the mountain." Tom was scared, but he wanted to be brave. So, he said, "Okay, Mom, let's go." They went to the big mountain and Tom started to climb. He was very brave.
As Tom climbed, he saw a big rock. He wanted to climb it, but he started to fall. His mom was worried. Just then, a big, soft man came to help. He held Tom and said, "I will help you." The man helped Tom back on the rock. Tom was so happy and proud. He learned that even when you are scared, it is important to be brave and try new things.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her blocks. She had many blocks of different colors and shapes. One day, she decided to build a big tower with her blocks.

As they were building, Lucy's mom came into the room. She saw how much fun they were having and wanted to help. So, she came up with a new idea. "Let's add more blocks to the tower!" she said. Lucy and Tom were so happy to see the tower full of blocks.
But then, Lucy's little brother, Max, came running. He bumped into the tower and the blocks fell down. Lucy was upset again, but Tom said, "It's okay! Let's try again!"
